in_marathi.name: Anvesha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anvesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anvesha is a Sanskrit word derived from the root ‘anu’ (towards) and ‘veshana’ (inquiring, searching). It symbolizes the deep, insatiable desire to explore the unknown and seek answers to life’s mysteries. In Hindu mythology, Anvesha is the name of a goddess who represents knowledge and wisdom.
